verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm docs describe the software stack as 'primarily open-source,' giving users freedom to inspect and customize it, but this refers to the driver/software stack rather than the GPU hardware or firmware itself, and no specific license name or repository link is given. missing for 10: explicit license identification, links to source repositories, confirmation that firmware/hardware design or full driver stack (not just 'primarily' open) is available under an open license.
